content.transcript: Remote work can reduce commuting time and give employees more flexibility, but it also changes how teams communicate. Informal conversations happen less often, so important context may not spread naturally. Organisations can respond by documenting decisions, scheduling focused collaboration, and avoiding unnecessary meetings. The speaker argues that remote work is most effective when flexibility is combined with clear communication practices.

key_points: remote work reduces commuting and adds flexibility
clear communication makes remote work more effective
answer.illustrative_response: The speaker explains that remote work saves commuting time and increases flexibility, but it can reduce informal communication and make context harder to share. Organisations can address this by documenting decisions, planning focused collaboration and limiting unnecessary meetings, combining flexibility with clear communication practices.
